title: MSL Shader Plan
description: A plan describing a set of Metal shaders and the GPU counters observed for them, for deterministic auditing against this skill's failure modes (bandwidth bandit, register pressure cascade / precision overkill, branch divergence, tile memory overflow, misaligned threadgroup size).

name.description: Shader function name, for locating findings in the source.

precision.description: Dominant precision used for the shader's display-bound working values.

usesFloatForDisplayBound.description: True if float (not half) is used for display-bound values like color/normal, where half would suffice.

runtimeBranchOnUniform.description: True if the shader branches at runtime on a uniform/material property instead of a compile-time function constant.

usesFunctionConstant.description: True if the shader uses function constants for compile-time specialization of variant behavior.

multiPassStoreLoad.description: True if this shader is part of a multi-pass pipeline that stores to and loads from a full render target between passes, rather than staying resident in tile memory.

memorylessIntermediates.description: True if intermediate render targets this shader writes are declared MTLStorageModeMemoryless (or equivalent) rather than backed by real memory.

occupancyPct.description: Measured GPU occupancy percentage (Instruments GPU profiler). Below 75% indicates register pressure or excessive threadgroup memory use.

registerUsagePct.description: Measured register usage as a percentage of the available register file. Above 80% risks spilling and occupancy loss.

tileMemoryKb.description: Tile memory used per tile, in kilobytes. Apple GPUs cap this at 32KB per tile.

threadgroupSize.description: Threadgroup size used for compute/tile dispatch. Should be a multiple of 32 (SIMD-group width) to avoid wasted lanes.
